profile.name: Keithley 6220精密恒流源
profile.description: Keithley 6220是一款单通道精密恒流源，用于输出稳定、可控的恒定电流。它适合器件电学表征、低电流偏置、材料测试和传感器测量等实验场景，主要用于电流激励而非传统多功能电源输出。
profile.description_en: The Keithley 6220 is a single-channel precision current source designed to deliver stable, controllable constant current. It is used in laboratory applications such as electrical characterization, low-current biasing, materials testing, and sensor measurements, where current excitation is needed rather than a general-purpose power supply output.
